ticket.name: Punched Ticket
ticket.description: Punched once, at a station that closed years ago.

arrival.title: Arrival
epilogue: The train stops. The doors open onto a platform that is not on any map you have seen.

return.title: Return
epilogue: You get off where you got on, and the night is only a night again.

platform.title: Platform Three
body: The departure board has been blank for eleven minutes.
"Last branch line," the guard says, and does not look up.

ticket_window.title: The Ticket Window
body: The glass is scratched opaque. A hand pushes a ticket through without being asked.

carriage.title: Carriage Seven
body: Empty, except for the smell of rain on upholstery.
Empty, and quiet in the way a room is quiet once you have paid for it.

choices.text: Show the punched ticket to the guard
Ask the guard about the branch line
Get off at the next stop

guard.title: The Guard
body: "It closed in eighty-seven," he says. "Nobody told the timetable."

choices.text: Ask him why he still runs it

back.title: The Next Stop
body: The doors open onto your own platform, eleven minutes before you left.
